upstream_math: For each KV head, average its grouped query-head causal observation attention scores, then average-pool kernel5, topk old positions, and retain32recent. Keep actual8KV heads; native attention expands transiently. Prefill remains full; decode compressed cache grows.
baseline_semantics: Changes selection relative to legacy per-query-head SnapKV. This is current upstream KV-head selector fidelity, not byte-equivalence to the legacy32-head comparator. No novelty claim.
adapter: gqa_snap_adapter.py uses current upstream selector without editing it; inherits existing projection capture/rollback but restores native GQA groups before execution; stores direct8KVheads and returns full uncompressed prefillKV.

paper_claim: Legacy expanded-head SnapKV alone cannot justify a memory SOTA claim; this stronger baseline should be measured before making such claims. Official repository explicitly marks wider GPUvalidation pending.
